owasp_api_cross_reference: API6:2023 Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows (coupon abuse, inventory integrity, missing business invariants)
summary: Checkout allows reusable coupons, negative line quantities, and race-condition stock overselling because business invariants, redemption tracking, idempotency, and DB constraints are missing.

evidence.description: Detection suite asserting single-use coupons, positive quantities, and atomic stock constraints; fails on vulnerable red-phase checkout.
